scope: Complete source and original-input recovery for the 33 explicitly enumerated part2 legacy numerical derivative outputs. All producers/helpers/parameters/proofs/active inputs remain. Exact old output bytes are restored from fixed Git; a new numerical replay is optional and is not a deletion/admission gate.
body_read_policy: Only whole text files below 100000 bytes and Git tree metadata were read. No binary/large output body was fetched or decompressed; no numerical producer, AST, CAS, fixture or local science was executed.
input_sha256_semantics: Input SHA256 values are copied from whole original small reports/plans and their recursive input_hashes, C upstream groups.chunks, and H's six-role input manifest. Git blob/size/path are independently read from the fixed original historical tree. Hashes of unread binaries are recorded original hashes, not newly computed. Every current-snapshot input present in that tree has the same Git blob.
input_discovery_scope: all original target input_hashes and nested previous/unchanged_original_input_hashes
C upstream full source summary, all 18 groups and every complete chunk, exact cut plan including physical whole geometry/budget
H six exact original working input roles and original path bindings
restoration_protocol: Restore required originals with git show COMMIT:TOPIC/PATH or the stated exact Git blob; preserve binary bytes unchanged. For H stage the six restored bytes at the exact recorded local paths or make an explicit new path-only manifest and record its new whole SHA. Restore retired dependencies before old readers; do not weaken a hash/source guard. Replay output timestamps, resource use and gzip bytes may differ; new output identity is never asserted equal to old merely because the mathematical recipe is unchanged.
